description: This file defines a C# class 'SimpleGrain' implementing the 'ISimpleGrain' interface, representing an Orleans grain that manages two integer arguments, allowing setting, incrementing, and multiplying them, with logging and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: SimpleGrain
classes.description: A class representing an Orleans grain that manages two integers and provides methods to set, increment, and multiply them, with lifecycle logging.

methods.name: SimpleGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger using the provided ILoggerFactory.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon grain activation, logs activation.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets the value of argument A.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets the value of argument B.

methods.name: IncrementA
methods.description: Increments the value of argument A by one.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns the product of A and B.

methods.name: GetAxB (overload)
methods.description: Returns the product of provided arguments a and b.

methods.name: GetA
methods.description: Returns the current value of argument A.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon grain deactivation, logs deactivation.
